name: peakoff-platform
description: PeakOff — Dynamic discount and customer-demand optimization platform connecting B2B venues with B2C real-time customer opportunities.

scripts.build: rm -rf public && mkdir -p public/dashboard && cp -r mobile/dist/* public/ && cp -r dashboard/dist/* public/dashboard/
scripts.check: node --check server.js && node --check src/engine.js && node --check src/grok.js && node --check api/ai.js && node --check dashboard/dist/app.js && node --check mobile/dist/app.js
